title: the tester-hook tooth lives in the tester's own proofs, and the artifact door's proof reads no tester path
intention: A tooth that reads the tester's pre-commit hook lives in the tester's own proofs; the artifact door's proof measures only the artifact door.
why: RULE 1: a ticket's proofs measure only its own component. Read 2026-11-13 at origin/main e077e5464: cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_artifact_door.py reads cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit (its teeth_hook installs the tester's pre-commit hook into a scratch clone and measures that the door's commit question runs before the reseal ladder), so the artifact tool's proof reaches into the tester device's code (RULE 1). Built at 6071e5e6c on akiendell: the moved tooth is GREEN; a hook with the question made non-fatal (`check ... || true`) reds tooth 1, and the old door proof reds tooth 3.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation); Law 8 (a proof a hollow build could not pass); tickets 30531f6e1c5d and 2a208067d036 (the keys moved)
how: D1: THE MOVE. The tester-hook tooth leaves cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_artifact_door.py for cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_tester_hook_asks_the_commit_question_first.py, keys kept: 30531f6e1c5d tester_hook and 2a208067d036 "2" move with it, and the door proof keeps a pointer comment where the tooth stood. The scratch clone takes its interpreter from the repo's bootstrap (cairn/devices/recovery/bootstrap.sh, cairn_python), writes the door's source body as LF JSON, and reads the marker from stdout and stderr both, because git hands a hook's stdout to stderr. D2: PROOFS. The new proof installs the real hook into a scratch cairn clone whose reseal step is a stand-in that prints a marker, so the ORDER is measured: a record staged around the door is refused with the marker absent, a record written through the door commits with the marker present, and the door proof contains no tester path.

clauses.claim: the tester's pre-commit hook refuses a record of truth staged around the artifact door before its reseal ladder runs (the stand-in marker is absent)
a record written through the artifact door commits through the same hook, and the reseal ladder runs after the question (the marker is present)
cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_artifact_door.py reads no path under cairn/devices/tester, and its PROVES no longer carries 30531f6e1c5d tester_hook or 2a208067d036 "2"
